Stop 🛑 throwing out perfectly good veggies, do this instead 👇🥒✨
Link to my jars can be found in my bio in my amazon storefront ❤

If you’re anything like me, you buy fresh veggies… then discover perfectly good ones still hiding in the fridge drawer. Instead of tossing them, I turn everything into the easiest homemade pickles and honestly, my family devours them every single time.

Just a few minutes, one, two, or three jars, and in a couple of days you’ve got the most delicious crunchy snack waiting for you. I promise this will become a regular in your home too 💛

How to make them:
• Any vegetables you have, cut up
• Add to a 1 L jar
• 2 tbsp kosher salt
• ½ cup white distilled vinegar
• Fill the rest with filtered water

Leave the jar on your counter for 2 days, then they’re ready to eat. I like to move mine to the refrigerator after that to keep them nice, cold, and crisp. They can last for months in the fridge… but realistically? Not a chance 😉

Prefer salt-only pickles? Skip the vinegar and add an extra ½ tbsp salt.
